# HP-12 live configured support-review qualification

Current semantic-floor readiness is reopened by [0047](../../../intent/decisions/0047-qualify-oracle-semantics-before-prompt-tuning.md).
The historical67 fixed-label matches below remain unchanged; they are not
independent proof that every oracle expresses strict entailment.

**Qualified for this frozen synthetic assertion-support site:** all 67 predeclared
cases completed and matched. This is not whole-document acceptance, source truth,
calibrated population accuracy, HITL completion, publication authority or UI entry.
The [receipt](receipt.json), [exact study bytes](study.json), [preparations](preparations.json),
[actual offline report](report.json) and [per-case native observations](results.json)
keep those boundaries explicit.

## Frozen before dispatch

Source `50e6cc2`, a clean darwin/arm64 Go 1.26.3 trimpath executable, both independent
scope pins, the v2 corpus, all 67 request/prepared digests, case order, pricing,
finite budget and stop rules were frozen before a credential was loaded or a
provider call started. The pre-dispatch Fathom thread `th-380aada8` names the exact
private freeze and executable hashes. An independent critic checked the driver;
its initial start-marker-before-key-validation issue was corrected and re-reviewed
before dispatch. All67 real-encoder preparations passed offline first.

Run order: 24 supported controls (12 exact, six paraphrases, six multi-fact syntheses)
then all 43 frozen unsupported assertions, across six document types. No generated
oracle, retry, repair, alternate root, provider fallback or omitted failing attempt.
The case-specific user payload contains only assertion, cited/contradiction fact
IDs and all facts. Case IDs, positive/negative kinds and expected labels were not sent.

The selected model, official identity/context and prices are recorded in study
data and were rechecked on 2026-10-25 against [model specifications](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview)
and [official pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing).
No explicit effort/thinking override or prompt cache was selected. The wire hash
pins the request, not provider model weights or future default behavior.

## Observed result

| Observation | Actual |
|---|---:|
| Planned / native attempts / completed matches | 67 / 67 / 67 |
| Supported controls / unsupported assertions | 24 / 43 |
| False support / false hold / inconclusive | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| Missing / pending / failed / unknown / invalid | 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 |
| Input / output / cached tokens | 104,281 / 6,256 / 0 |
| Local usage-priced cohort cost | $0.271122 |
| Prior direct stage + this cohort | $0.052716 + $0.271122 = $0.323838 |
| Native-call latency p50 / p95 / max | 1.694s / 2.420s / 3.387s |

Each response was HTTP 200, end_turn, the selected resolved model and ordinary text.
The journal reserved 4,040,960 microdollars before each attempt under one 5,000,000
microdollar ceiling. Present usage released unused reservation; failed/unknown
attempts would retain it. The first nonzero/mismatched/incomplete observation would
have stopped further calls. The original failed v1 document cell remains failed
and its exhausted repair remains exhausted; this separate site cohort does not
retry, regrade or replace it.

## Independent checks and custody

The owner and a separate critic independently reconstructed all 67 native decisions,
request/prepared hashes, marker/receipt/rationale bindings, resolved models, native
stop/usage and per-case/cumulative accounting. Repricing the native tokens produced
exactly 271,122 microdollars. No extra reservations/outcomes/calls were present. All67
actual capture receipts and the actual report passed their CUE contracts.

Strict plan verification checks the published qualification reading through a
lexical contract. It does not call a provider or authenticate the private journal.
Actual cohort evidence comes from the separately executed native reconciliation.

The native timer includes reservation and provider call but excludes outcome
persistence and prior-case replay; it is not end-to-end task latency. Separate
process timings are in the receipt. Native responses and rationales stay private.
Public hashes identify retained bytes, not cryptographic provider authentication.
No credential or hidden reasoning text is published. Charges are local usage-priced
estimates at frozen rates, not invoices, account balances or demonstrated savings.
Cost per accepted document is undefined because this experiment accepted no document.

To reproduce preparation, use the normal review-prepare command from
[prose-lab guidance](../../../../cmd/prose-lab/README.md) with this study.json, the
unchanged v2 corpus and both scope pins in receipt.json. Reproducing preparation
needs no key. A fresh live run requires a separately predeclared experiment within the owner's
existing authority and cumulative budget; do not reopen or retry this journal. Offline native replay
requires the operator's retained private journal and artifact root.

## Remaining acceptance

This qualifies one configured reviewer against these 67 synthetic controls once.
It does not qualify all structural prose nodes, unknown/restricted source truth,
long documents, independent document goals/clarity/audience, local/broad revision,
group publication, real human/agent authority or an app host. HP-06/07/09 and the
broader PH/HW/PX and governed-command goals remain open. The app-kit UI lane stays
gated by HP-A18. Prior held cells, coding-review soft-budget failures and stage
spend remain in their respective denominators.
